summary: The compatibility polygon is derived exactly from the three facets of the translated simplex, and the equivalent containment Q-2v in Delta has the same three inequalities with the correct signs. The halfspace normalization, boundary translation, slice thresholds, use of Q-2v containment, centroid-cap and two-cap estimates, horizontal-normal cases, strict boundary handling, arithmetic, and application of the accepted middle-slice criterion are all correct, including on the boundary of the full translation triangle.
